title: Rio Grande Valley Romance Author Lizzy Goldmoon to Sign Books at Laredo Barnes & Noble Saturday
excerpt: Rio Grande Valley romance author Lizzy Goldmoon will meet readers and sign copies of her books at Barnes & Noble in Laredo on Saturday, Nov. 28, from 2 to 4 p.m., according to the Laredo Morning Times and the store's announcement.
content:
Rio Grande Valley romance author Lizzy Goldmoon will meet readers and sign copies of her books at Barnes & Noble in Laredo on Saturday, Nov. 28, according to the Laredo Morning Times and the store’s announcement.

The signing runs from 2 to 4 p.m. at the store at 5300 San Dario Ave., Suite 240. Goldmoon is listed as an author event participant, and readers can meet her, buy a book or get a copy signed.

Her books include “Mathematical Equations,” part of The College Chronicles series, and “You Reminded Me,” published earlier this month.

The Laredo stop follows bookstore signings in McAllen on Nov. 21 and San Antonio on Nov. 10.

Sources: Laredo Morning Times, Nov. 27, 2026; Barnes & Noble Laredo.
